spec.description: Production Linux host monitoring dashboard using Prometheus Node Exporter. Covers CPU, load, memory, swap, filesystem, disk I/O, network, file descriptors and process health.

spec.title: Host Uptime
spec.description: Time since the Linux host booted.

spec.title: Memory Usage
spec.description: Host memory utilization based on MemAvailable.

spec.expr: 100 * (1 - (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{instance=~"$instance", job=~"$job", mountpoint="/", fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{instance=~"$instance", job=~"$job", mountpoint="/", fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"}))

spec.title: Load Average
spec.description: Linux load average over 1, 5 and 15 minutes.

spec.title: Swap Usage
spec.description: Swap usage. Sustained swap growth may indicate memory pressure.

spec.title: Disk IOPS
spec.description: Disk operations per second by device.

spec.title: Node Exporter - Linux Host Infrastructure
